Nduja Fritta Tanto is named after the

, a spicy, spreadable pork sausage from the Italian Calabria region. "Fritta Tanto" translates to "fried a lot/fried too much" in Italian. A property of capsaicin is that when it is exposed to heat, it increases its potency, so if a person overcooks 'nduja, it would result in a spicy dish.
